title: Duel of the Jedi Masters
front_description: Yoda masterfully outmaneuvers Count Dooku, who rains down on his Jedi opponent with a vicious lightsaber frontal assault. For the first part of the contest, Yoda parries every cut and thrust that his enemy aims at him...nothing the great swordsman tries gets through. Then, Yoda attacks, flying forward. Words are insufficient to describe the range of Yoda's skill and swordplay. His lightsaber is a humming blur of energy.
back_description: Dooku's ship is, in truth, a full-size prop on a sound stage.
